title: get_changes_since exported but wrong for maxChanges pagination — footgun
description: ContactStore::get_changes_since is still pub and appears in the public API alongside get_changes_since_ordered. The doc comment warns that callers using maxChanges must use get_changes_since_ordered instead. A future contributor browsing the API will naturally reach for get_changes_since (shorter name) and get subtly wrong newState under pagination without a compile error. Options: make get_changes_since pub(crate) or remove it if no internal callers remain (ChatContactChangesHandler now uses _ordered).
